digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler retry and outcome contract (Cloud/DC)
propositions: Nested Jira write retries across SDK/wrapper/subprocess layers risk timeout-multiplied writes or acceptance ambiguity; a unified provider-neutral retry budget with observe-before-replay recovery must enforce at most three invocations and 15s cumulative sleep per operation
Cloud executor must spawn one ACLI process per write with POSIX/non-POSIX cleanup and sanitized exit/stdout/stderr decoding; recovery must use exactly one primary-store REST request with no sleep
DC executor must use jira.JIRA(..., max_retries=0) and fail fast if _session.max_retries != 0; each summary-write invocation is exactly GET→PUT→GET with no hidden repeats

Selected summary-only exact-field writes bypass generic _call_with_retry; mixed fields remain one legacy call; constructor-injected internal route selector defaults to legacy in S1 (no config/env surface)

Every terminal outcome must emit exactly one redacted completion log with only logical id, disposition, invocation/request count, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one message ≤512 code points; total log ≤1,024 code points; no baseline/provenance advance or S1 deferral persists

Desired summary observed after timeout is recovered success; conclusive old state permits only remaining-budget replay; failed/rate-limited/inconclusive returns non-replaying commit_unknown; over-budget delay returns retry_not_before without sleep
